## Research

### Independent Researcher — Complexity Science and Pension Systems
2025 – present · Porto

- Completing the doctoral dissertation *Dynamics of Retirement Pension Systems: A Generational Approach* (supervisor during doctoral studies: Prof. Luís Antunes, FCUL), begun in the International Doctoral Programme in Complexity Sciences (Iscte-IUL / FCUL); the programme was discontinued in 2025.
- Agent-based model of retirement timing combining Goal-Framing Theory worker types with option-value pension incentives; NetLogo driven from R, mean-field companion model, Julia/Agents.jl port in progress.
- Manuscripts in preparation for journals in social simulation and retirement research.
- Preprint: Bacelar & Antunes (2019), [Generational political dynamics of retirement pension systems: an agent-based model](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08706), arXiv:1909.08706.

## Professional Experience

### Statistics Portugal (INE)
1990 – 2024

**Statistics Administrator, Department of Demographic and Social Statistics** (2014–2024)

- Responsible for the production of the Well-being Index of Portugal.
- Led the revision and development of the National Gender Database (labour market, education, work–life balance, decision-making, health).
- Member, UNECE Task Force on Measurement of Well-being (2023–2024).

**Statistics Administrator, Metadata Unit / Department of Methodology and Information Systems** (2003–2013)

- Coordinator, ESSnet on SDMX WP2: Metadata Common Vocabulary Ontology (Eurostat).
- Design of the metadata conceptual and documentation subsystems; metadata usability testing.
- Member, SDMX Metadata Task Force (Eurostat); member, Common Metadata Framework Part B Task Force (UNECE).

**Consultant to the Administration Board** (2001–2003)

- Statistical dissemination; cooperation projects in Cape Verde (Official Statistics Database, World Bank funded, 2002) and Mauritius (COMESA seminar on statistics dissemination, 2003).

**Head of Unit, North Directorate** (1990–2001)

- Studies and dissemination; social and demographic statistics; IT and statistical projects.
- Participant, European project *AD1013 Rainbow — An Object Network for Statisticians and Administrators* (EC Telematics Applications Programme).
- Regional coordinator (North), 1991 Population and Housing Census.
